rationale: Lydia's deep expertise in developer experience and technical education complements Manolo's focus on making voice AI production-ready and reliable. While Lydia works on making complex developer tools accessible through visual content and tooling at Anthropic's Claude Code team, Manolo is building the audio intelligence layer for voice systems with an emphasis on studio-quality preprocessing and production reliability—two sides of making AI infrastructure usable in the real world rather than just in demos.
intro_message: Lydia Hallie, meet Manolo Espinosa — you both care deeply about moving AI from labs to production (DX and tooling for Lydia, audio reliability for voice systems for Manolo), and there's potential overlap in how to communicate technical complexity to builders.
